nextStoryContext: Pure JSDoc fix: replaced the stale 'Default: 5 000.' line in the idleTimeoutMs field doc of issue.ts/review.ts/spec.ts with a reference to `IDLE_WAIT_DEADLINE_MS` (30 000 ms, defined in src/tmux/dispatch.ts), matching dispatch.ts's own JSDoc convention. The added line pushed issue.ts (209->210) and review.ts (207->208) past their file-size-budget ceilings; raised both ceilings in scripts/file-size-budget.json with a dated _ref note (spec.ts stayed within its existing ceiling, no raise needed there). No runtime behavior changed; test count unchanged at 5249 pass / 0 fail.
